name: io.github.rafaemush/oilflow-mcp-server
title: OilFlow Compliance
description: Verifiable compliance evidence for agent decisions: screen counterparties against 8 sanctions lists and a first-party fraud-cluster registry, check tradability across 235 jurisdictions, run pre-deal checks. Every verdict states its coverage and evidence gaps; receipts carry a verifiable signature. Three tools need no API key. PEP screening is not offered.

environmentVariables.name: OILFLOW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Unlocks the keyed tools; the three keyless tools work without it.
